g.text: UC02 - one paid cycle per intent (REVIEW)
authorize caller; resolve key + canonical content
coordinate MAIN, verify owner (eligibility rechecked after all locks)
fresh DB eligibility AFTER all root/cycle coordination; recheck expiry/funds
start=coverageEnd if continuous, else this valid processing instant
